title: bromus scoparius var. humilis
intro: Bromus scoparius var. humilis, commonly known as Small Brome or Humble Brome, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of Small Brome include reducing fever, soothing digestive issues, and treating respiratory problems such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
